acceptanceCriteria: Impact for a controller change lists the matching request spec with a named advisory witness (test)
Unmatched controllers abstain rather than guess
The conformance row is updated; contextindex/NGI or RUBY spec amended
body: Residual from V1-1799 (PR #1156, rows.json controller-spec row). Changing app/controllers/users_controller.rb lists no spec/requests/users_spec.rb in impact; only affected selection reaches it as ADVISORY_CONSTANT_REFERENCE. Expected: impact names the request spec with an advisory witness (conventional controller-to-request-spec mapping or config/routes.rb reading).
title: Ruby impact: a controller change does not reach its request spec (no route-dispatch rule)
